items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy and dry to start this evening, then cloud thickening with rain arriving before midnight, this falling as snow over the hills. Fresh to strong southeast wind continuing to increase to gale force, especially over high ground.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 0°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

East or Southeast 25-35 gusts 40-45


##Visibility##

Good, moderate or poor in precipitation later.


##Comments##

Gales. Snow on hills. Heavy rain risk.


##Tomorrow##

Rain through the night, turning heavy at times with a risk of surface water flooding, especially in the west, and initially falling as snow on hills, above about 1000 feet. Blizzards for a time on highest parts, but turning to rain towards or around dawn. Rain the turning patchier by the afternoon. Gale force east or southeast winds may touch severe gale force through early hours to lee of hills around parts of west with gusts of 60mph, before then steadily easing through day and veering southwest. Top temperature 10°C.

##Comments##

Gale force winds at first/ severe in places. Snow accumulations on hills at first. Heavy rain with a risk of flooding, especially in the west.
